title: New Acquisition: Stephen Shore - Modern Instances
excerpt: The library has acquired Stephen Shore's seminal work 'Modern Instances', a definitive survey of the photographer's color work from 1970-1986.
content: We're pleased to announce the acquisition of 'Modern Instances: The Craft of Photography' by Stephen Shore (Mack, 2024). This comprehensive monograph documents Shore's pioneering work in color photography and his influence on contemporary image-making. The 448-page volume includes previously unpublished photographs alongside Shore's own writings on the craft of photography. This important addition to our photography collection is now available for viewing by appointment. The book joins our existing holdings of Shore's 'Uncommon Places' and early conceptual works, creating a substantial archive of this influential artist's practice.
